title: Pair-partition mechanism behind the Blitvić hypothesis
html:
Remark. Pair-partition mechanism behind the Blitvić hypothesis

Blitvić's theorem applies when joint moments \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_{i_1} \sigma_{i_2} \cdots \sigma_{i_k}) decompose as a sum over pair-partitions \pi with weights depending only on \pi and q. The Hecke relation \sigma_i^2 = (q - q^{-1})\sigma_i + 1 reduces every generator word to a combination of square-free products, and the Markov property then evaluates the trace as a sum over matchings — the mechanism realising the hypothesis of prop:hecke-satisfies-blitvic-hypothesis.
